file_insights.description: Implementation of CadenceZones methods: get_zone(), get_zone_range(), and all_zones()

patterns_discovered: Consistent zone method pattern across different zone types (PowerZones, HRZones, CadenceZones)
Zone range determination through max_rpm attribute
Flexible zone lookup with Option return type for zone ranges
Vector-based method for retrieving all zones
gotchas_discovered: Hardcoded zone boundaries based on max_rpm values
No validation for zero or out-of-bounds zone numbers
recommendations: Add input validation for get_zone() method
Implement unit tests to verify zone determination logic
Add documentation for zone method behavior and edge cases
